reason: The WS-07 sequence is an accounting outline, not an executable baseline fixture. A semantically equivalent trial cannot be run without inventing inputs that materially determine the primitive count and result.
missing_executable_inputs: Concrete pre-UEREMCP emitter template refPath values for all six semantic roles.
Concrete NiagaraTypeDefinition and default-value payloads for primary colour, secondary colour, scale, and intensity; the WS-07 sequence explicitly leaves the AddUserVariables/SetVariable split TBD.
Concrete renderer references and rendererData.propertyValues payloads for six equivalent material bindings.

A specified primitive material chain for each role. The sequence permits either WS-08 create_vfx_material goal operations or Epic MaterialTools/MaterialInstanceTools, which have different call grain and therefore cannot be selected interchangeably for a measured primitive baseline.
A deterministic compile-poll termination/count policy and a concrete package-save primitive list.
honesty_constraints: No partial asset was created because it would not meet the semantic target.
The planned 17 known Niagara operations are not reported as measured.
UEREMCP internal_operations=46 is not substituted for the primitive baseline.
close_condition: WS-07 must provide one executable fixture/script with fixed emitter templates, variable payloads, renderer payloads, material primitive chain, compile polling, save, and reread assertions; then run at least one clean timed trial (the existing handoff requests three).
